translation: My mother tongue is the cradle of wisdom.
notes: Literary poetic expression celebrating native language.

translation: A stone is most precious where it belongs (where it falls).
notes: This is one of the most famous proverbs used by Uyghurs, especially those living abroad. It signifies that a person has the most dignity, value, and peace in their own homeland or where their roots are planted.

source_arabic: شىنجاڭ ئۇنىۋېرسىتېتى ئۈرۈمچىدە. بۇ ئۇنىۋېرسىتېت بەك چوڭ. ئۇنىۋېرسىتېتتا يىگىرمە ئۈچ ئىنستىتۇت، بىر ئاسپىرانتۇرا بار. شىنجاڭ ئۇنىۋېرسىتېتىدا ئۇيغۇر تىلى ۋە ئەدەبىياتى، فىزىكا، خىمىيە، ماتېماتىكا قاتارلىق ئىنستىتۇتلار بار. بۇ ئۇنىۋېرسىتېتتا يىگىرمە بەش مىڭ ئوقۇغۇچى بار. ئۇلاردىن يىگىرمە مىڭ ئوقۇغۇچى-باكالاۋر، بەش مىڭ ئوقۇغۇچى-ماگىستىر.
source_latin: Shinjang uniwérsitéti Ürümchide. Bu uniwérsitét bek chong. Uniwérsitétta yigirme üch institut, bir aspirantura bar. Shinjang uniwérsitétida uyghur tili we edebiyati, fizika, ximiye, matématika qatarliq institutlar bar. Bu uniwérsitétta yigirme besh ming oqughuchi bar. Ulardin yigirme ming oqughuchi-bakalawr, besh ming oqughuchi-magistir.
translation: Xinjiang university is in Urumchi. This university is very big. There are 23 undergraduate programs and one graduate program at the university. At the university, there are undergraduate programs such as Uyghur Language and Literature, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, etc. There are 25,000 students at this university. Of the 25,000 students, 20,000 are bachelor's students and 5,000 are master's students.
notes: This is a text translated from the Uyghur: An Elementary Textbook.
